Ready to expand your horizons? It’s easy in the Nissan Titan.® It starts with a
powerful standard V8 engine that hits the road with up to 9,500 lbs. of towing
capacity.1 Underneath, a fully boxed ladder frame handles just about any job on
the list, while Titan®’s cabin and bed give you Nissan innovation plus plenty of
room. 2015 Nissan Titan.® No matter how epic your plans, it’s ready.
